title: Quantum-Inspired Unitary Pooling for Multispectral Satellite Image Classification
summary: Multispectral satellite imagery poses significant challenges for deep learning models due to the high dimensionality of spectral data and the presence of structured correlations across channels. Recent work in quantum machine learning suggests that unitary evolutions and Hilbert-space embeddings can introduce useful inductive biases for learning. In this work, we show that several empirical advantages often attributed to quantum feature maps can be more precisely understood as consequences of geometric structure induced by unitary group actions and the associated quotient symmetries.…
